transcriptionCloud.label: Allow cloud transcription
transcriptionCloud.help: Sends audio to external services such as Deepgram / OpenAI / ElevenLabs Scribe. When OFF, this drive uses local Whisper only.

chapterSuggestions.label: Allow AI chapter suggestions
chapterSuggestions.help: Sends media transcripts to the configured LLM to create chapter candidates. Candidates are never applied until you approve them.
chapterSuggestions.warning: Chapter suggestion jobs already in progress will continue after you turn this OFF. Restart the container to apply the change immediately.

llmCloud.label: Allow cloud LLMs
llmCloud.help: Sends this drive's file content, transcripts and images to LLM profiles marked as off-host. When OFF, only local profiles are used, and features without a local profile do not run.
llmCloud.warning: Jobs already in progress will finish after you turn this OFF.

indexing.label: Indexing
indexing.help: Picks up file changes and updates the semantic search index. When OFF, new files are not included in search.

search.label: Semantic search
search.help: Enables semantic search in the search screen. When OFF, intelligence search is disabled; filename search still works.

rag.label: AI question answering (Ask)
rag.help: Enables Ask. Each question sends file contents such as captions and text to the LLM API.

auto_tags.label: AI tag candidates
auto_tags.help: Creates tag candidates from file contents. Manual only creates them when requested; Auto creates them during indexing. Candidates are not applied until you add them.

summaries.label: AI summary (short)
summaries.help: Creates a one-sentence summary and a slightly longer paragraph summary. Auto creates summaries per file, increasing usage.

detailed_summaries.label: AI detailed summary (Markdown)
detailed_summaries.help: Creates a longer summary with a key-points table. Auto can use a lot per file, so a local LLM or lower-cost LLM is recommended.

transcript_refine.label: AI transcript cleanup
transcript_refine.help: Cleans up transcripts with an LLM, including punctuation and homophone fixes. This cannot be undone: getting the original back means transcribing the file again. Full transcripts are sent to the LLM API.

vision_describe.label: AI image description
vision_describe.help: Creates image descriptions with an LLM. Image data is sent to the LLM API. For drives with private photos, use Off or a local vision model. Requires vision_model to be set on the LLM provider.

retrieval_keywords.label: AI search keyword expansion
retrieval_keywords.help: Creates helper keywords such as synonyms, abbreviations, and alternate names per file, then stores them in a dedicated search index. This helps cover proper nouns that speech recognition may misread. Transcript or document text (up to 8,000 characters) is sent to the LLM API.

chapter_suggestions.label: AI chapter candidates
chapter_suggestions.help: Creates chapter candidates from media transcripts. Manual only creates them when requested; Auto creates them during indexing. Candidates are not applied until you approve the whole set.

video_visual_index.label: Visual index
video_visual_index.help: Builds a seekable index of representative video frames with AI-written descriptions. Frame images and nearby transcript text are sent to the configured Vision model. For private libraries, use Off or a local vision model. Requires llm.vision_model to be set.
